subject: Air freight quote to ATL
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in air freight quote in EUR for the fastest option to ATL (Atlanta, US)?

We’ll have 10 pieces of laboratory glassware ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 41007 (Moenchengladbach), Germany. The gross weight is 1754 kg and the total volume is 6.83 cbm. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include it in the quote.

Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer? Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
